## [0.9.1] - 2026-09-22

### 变更
- 「音量合成器」与「声音设置」打开的窗口现在居中显示在所在显示器上，不再停在 Windows 记住的位置（音量合成器此前落在屏幕左上角）。

### Changed
- The windows opened by **Volume mixer** and **Sound settings** are now centered on the monitor they land on instead of opening at the position Windows remembered (the volume mixer used to land in the top-left corner).
